messages:
kai: FYI nightly h100-smoke shard-7 is red. Errors look like driver/kernel mismatch + invalid device function. Planning a rerun + bisect but wanted quick checks before escalating.
matt: can you paste the tail logs and the image sha?
kai: tail of failing task (cut):
```
[2026-03-16T04:12:03Z] ERROR: runtime: cuda error: invalid device function
[2026-03-16T04:12:03Z] ERROR: cudaGetLastError -> invalid device function
[2026-03-16T04:12:04Z] NVML: Xid 31, GPU 0
[2026-03-16T04:12:04Z] INFO: Host driver: 525.85.12, Container CUDA: 12.2
[2026-03-16T04:12:04Z] IMAGE: ghcr.io/redwood/nightly-inference:2026-03-16@sha256:abc123def456
```
matt: hmm host driver 525.85 vs container expecting 12.2 — that combo should be supported but JIT/PTX incompat can still cause invalid device function. Any PTX/JIT logs?
oliver: quick checks: 1) nvidia-smi -q (driver modules), 2) check dmesg for kernel WARN/Xid 79/31, 3) try a single-job rerun pinned to same image on a known-good host.
sara: I can repro on a dev box with that image in ~15m. If rerun is flaky we can bisect commits between last-green and HEAD.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by @matt: /rerun job shard-7 (job-id: 45234). Started.
kai: manual rerun kicked. If it reproduces consistently we should try: set ENV CUDA_PTX_JIT=0 and rerun to see if it's a JIT fallback issue, then schedule a bisect.
deploy-bot: heads-up: host driver rollout to 525.x started in us-west-2 yesterday evening; can correlate with first-fail timestamps.
matt: if rerun comes back with same invalid device function + no OOM, likely kernel/ptx mismatch. If we see OOM spikes, reduce batch_size and retest.
kai: good plan. tagging @sara to follow up with repro logs and I'll open a bisect ticket only if rerun reproduces. :eyes:
